name: workspace-naming-policy
purpose: Defines naming conventions for root projects, reserved workspace folders, tools, skills, specs, history artifacts, docs, configs, source files, identifiers, and commits.

reader_guide.summary: Open this file before naming or renaming projects, folders, tools, skills, specs, configs, docs, generated artifacts, or commits. It explains the default case style, allowed exceptions, and audit command.
how_to_read: Read default_principles before creating a new name.
Read namespaces to find the convention for the folder or artifact type.
Read exceptions before renaming an existing special file.
Run audit_command after adding, moving, or renaming durable files and folders.
update_triggers: A new namespace or artifact type needs a naming rule.
A project, tool, skill, workflow, prompt, spec, history artifact, or config is renamed.
A naming-audit false positive or false negative appears.
An external ecosystem convention conflicts with the workspace default.
The user asks for naming, folder structure, or source structure rules.

reference_links.title: Python Packaging User Guide - src layout vs flat layout
Google Style Guides
used_for: local convention should follow project/language convention

structure_rules.rule: A durable name must reveal its owning scope and artifact type without requiring chat history.
structure_rules.reason: The user wants the repository to become easier to understand over time from folders and files alone.

structure_rules.rule: Use lowercase kebab-case for project, tool, skill, prompt, workflow, spec slug, and human-facing Markdown file slugs unless the ecosystem has a stronger convention.
structure_rules.reason: Kebab-case is readable in URLs, shell paths, docs, and repository navigation.

structure_rules.rule: Use snake_case for Python package names, module files, function names, and JSON object field names.
structure_rules.reason: Python and JSON ecosystem conventions differ from human-facing path slugs.

structure_rules.rule: Use YYYY-MM-DD-<lower-kebab-slug> for dated specs, research, plans, evaluations, and history artifacts.
structure_rules.reason: Date prefixes make long-running work sortable and traceable.

structure_rules.rule: Use name.ko.md and name.en.md for important bilingual durable docs.
structure_rules.reason: The user reads Korean docs while prompt/runtime material can stay English.

structure_rules.rule: Do not rename existing durable paths without a migration plan, trace update, and validation run.
structure_rules.reason: Many docs, specs, dashboards, and generated maps link to existing paths.

field_guide.meaning: Small set of naming principles used when no namespace-specific rule is stronger.
Artifact-specific naming rules with examples and audit behavior.
Allowed names that intentionally do not follow the default convention.
Deterministic command for checking enforceable naming rules.

default_principles: Prefer names that describe ownership, artifact type, and purpose.
Prefer one naming convention per namespace over case-style mixing.
Keep names lowercase in paths unless the ecosystem requires uppercase.
Avoid abbreviations unless they are common in the ecosystem or already established in this repository.
Prefer adding a clear new file over renaming linked durable history without a migration plan.

namespaces.case: lower-kebab filename, snake_case JSON fields, lower-kebab name/id values
